purpose: Convert a qualified workflow assessment into a buildable, reviewable scope artifact without starting build or creating commercial authority.
rules: LIGHTWEIGHT_FREE may summarize scope direction but must not provide full implementation architecture
PAID_DISCOVERY may contain deeper technical planning when commercially authorised
Blueprint approval does not authorize BUILDING
Blueprint approval does not create a binding price
Quotation remains a separate human-approved commercial artifact
Material unresolved assumptions prevent quote-ready status
Dependencies and third-party access must be evidenced before they are treated as ready
Customer-approved scope snapshot must be versioned and immutable after approval; later changes use Change Request
